summary: Page B2. Target story, by staff writer J. Stryker Meyer, reports Trenton State College's board of trustees voted 4-1 to arm campus patrolmen for a six-month trial starting September 1. 'The Signal' (the campus student newspaper) and 'Utimme/La Voz Oculta,' described as the weekly minority publication on campus, opposed the move; the student Minority Executive Council also opposed it. Rest of the page is a 'People' gossip column (Princess Anne, Ti-Grace Atkinson, Stepin Fetchit's stroke), weather, and garden-center ads.
